title: STEM Coding & Robotics Training
short: Structured, practical coding and robotics education for learners of all ages: Scratch, Python, web development, and hands-on robotics.
text: Our core service. We deliver structured, practical coding and robotics education to learners of all ages, from block-based Scratch programming for younger beginners right through to Python, web development, and physical computing with robotics kits.

title: Web & App Development
short: Websites and mobile apps from concept to launch, and training for people who want to build their own.
text: Building websites and mobile apps from concept to launch: responsive, user-focused, and maintained. We also train individuals and groups who want to build their own web or mobile solutions.
for: Individuals wanting to learn to build

title: Curriculum & Teaching Aids
short: Curricula and teaching materials that help schools introduce and deliver STEM topics clearly and confidently.
text: Structured curricula and hands-on teaching materials that help schools introduce and deliver STEM topics clearly, consistently, and with confidence, whether or not they already have technical staff in place.
for: Schools introducing STEM for the first time

title: AI & Tech Solutions
short: Helping organisations use AI tools, improve digital workflows, and reduce workload.
text: Helping organisations use technology more effectively: from introducing practical AI tools for teachers and teams, to IT systems advice, digital workflow design, and deploying AI-powered tools that reduce workload and improve output.
